record.bible_text: In those days<WH03117> <FI>there was<Fi> no king<WH04428> in Israel<WH03478>: and in those days<WH03117> the tribe<WH07626> of the Danites<WH01839> sought<WH01245><WTH8764> them an inheritance<WH05159> to dwell in<WH03427><WTH8800>; for unto that day<WH03117> <FI>all their<Fi> inheritance<WH05159> had not fallen<WH05307><WTH8804> unto them among<WH08432> the tribes<WH07626> of Israel<WH03478>.

And they said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Ask counsel<WH07592><WTH8798>, we pray thee, of God<WH0430>, that we may know<WH03045><WTH8799> whether our way<WH01870> which we go<WH01980><WTH8802> shall be prosperous<WH06743><WTH8686>.
And the priest<WH03548> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, Go<WH03212><WTH8798> in peace<WH07965>: before<WH05227> the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> your way<WH01870> wherein ye go<WH03212><WTH8799>.<CM>

Then the five<WH02568> men<WH0582> departed<WH03212><WTH8799>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Laish<WH03919>, and saw<WH07200><WTH8799> the people<WH05971> that <FI>were<Fi> therein<WH07130>, how they dwelt<WH03427><WTH8802> careless<WH0983>, after the manner<WH04941> of the Zidonians<WH06722>, quiet<WH08252><WTH8802> and secure<WH0982><WTH8802>; and <FI>there was<Fi> no magistrate<WH03423><WTH8802><WH06114> in the land<WH0776>, that might put <FI>them<Fi> to shame<WH03637><WTH8688> in <FI>any<Fi> thing<WH01697>; and they <FI>were<Fi> far<WH07350> from the Zidonians<WH06722>, and had no business<WH01697> with <FI>any<Fi>  man<WH0120>. <RF>Laish: also called, Leshem<Rf> <RF>magistrate: Heb. possessor, or, heir of restraints<Rf>
And they came<WH0935><WTH8799> unto their brethren<WH0251> to Zorah<WH06881> and Eshtaol<WH0847>: and their brethren<WH0251> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, What <FI>say<Fi> ye?

And they said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, that we may go up<WH05927><WTH8799> against them: for we have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> the land<WH0776>, and, behold, it <FI>is<Fi> very<WH03966> good<WH02896>: and <FI>are<Fi> ye still<WH02814><WTH8688>? be not slothful<WH06101><WTH8735> to go<WH03212><WTH8800>, <FI>and<Fi> to enter<WH0935><WTH8800> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> the land<WH0776>.

And they said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Hold thy peace<WH02790><WTH8685>, lay<WH07760><WTH8798> thine hand<WH03027> upon thy mouth<WH06310>, and go<WH03212><WTH8798> with us, and be to us<WH01961><WTH8800> a father<WH01> and a priest<WH03548>: <FI>is it<Fi> better<WH02896> for thee to be a priest<WH03548> unto the house<WH01004> of one<WH0259> man<WH0376>, or that thou be a priest<WH03548> unto a tribe<WH07626> and a family<WH04940> in Israel<WH03478>?

<FI> And<Fi> when they were a good way<WH07368><WTH8689> from the house<WH01004> of Micah<WH04318>, the men<WH0582> that <FI>were<Fi> in the houses<WH01004> near to Micah's<WH04318> house<WH01004> were gathered together<WH02199><WTH8738>, and overtook<WH01692><WTH8686> the children<WH01121> of Dan<WH01835>.
